goals: Verify that the panic function successfully throws an error when called
Verify that generatePropsFromAttributes correctly evaluates and generates properties from standard attributes and does not skip ref attributes
Verify that the memoize function correctly caches execution results and prevents redundant function calls for the same arguments
activities: Execute the panic function with an error message and verify that it throws an exception
Execute generatePropsFromAttributes with a sample attribute object and scope
Verify that the generated properties deeply match the expected object
Execute generatePropsFromAttributes with a sample reference object and scope
Verify that the generated properties deeply match the expected object including the ref
Create a memoized function that increments the counter
Invoke the memoized function twice with the same argument
Verify that the counter is only incremented once
